items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: we went often to the Metropole bar where Red Allen was leading a band... Red would tell him to kiss the baby and he would insist until the fellow kissed the woman. He had me kissing Lily in public at least twice every time we went to the place.

ctx.x: We sailed on the Liberte which was a fine ship and we enjoyed every mile from Le Havre to New York. I played a few numbers at the gala nights in each class which takes place on different nights. I had been in contact with Oran "Hot Lips" Page who had engaged a hotel in New York for us. He along with some other friends were at the pier to meet us when we docked at the pier at 6.a.m. the 7th of April. We stayed in the Apple until the 15th and I saw many of my friends, my best pals al Hall and Dickie Wells, and many…

Charlie Shavers was leading the other group at the Metropole and the joint was jumping every night. Red featured a song called "Kiss the Baby" and any fellow that was with a woman, Red would ask if she was the baby. If the fellow said yes, then Red would tell him to kiss the baby and he would insist until the fellow kissed the woman. He had me kissing Lily in public at least twice every time we went to the place. Another thing he would do was when a musician came into the bar, that he knew, and he knew many, Red…

"Lips" Page who had a son of 15 years old, was remarried with a school teacher, Elysabeth. They invited us for dinner and we enjoyed being with them. Lips was a natural born joker and terrific company. We stayed late and told him that we wanted to get back to our hotel and wanted to look for a cab. He said that it was not necessary. He would take us back as he had a big new model Cadillac but had to go in the street to look for someone who could drive it. We didn't dig it. Why couldn't he drive it himself? He…
